catalog.cause: Immersion ownership was memory-only; historical workers leaked after restart. Existing seats never reordered during browsing.
catalog.fix: Durable exact worker ownership, bounded real-work age cohorts, visible idle/blocker context, retained searchable empty history.

continuation.cause: An external-dependency worker repeatedly reported continue after unchanged inbox waits, resetting prompt continuation backoff.
continuation.fix: Durable dependency hold, explicit waitingDependency checkpoint, single-use material release signals and stored-only scheduled reports.
continuation.qualification: 48 simulated hours and restart produced zero polling reads and zero model starts for parked work; known transient recovery suite retained.

liveAudit.tokenLimit: Whole observed window includes some useful coordination; counters do not establish charged allowance or exact wasted cost.

android.unitBuildLint: Passed signed debug/release build, debug unit tests and release lint.
android.physical: Pixel in-place matching-signer upgrade verified versionCode61/alpha43. Actual list inspected with real roots/parent agent groups. Phone locked before individual owner search checks; owner labels/status/blocker independently verified in live API.

limits: Cached token counters are model transport statistics, not a subscription billing conversion.
Existing voice spoken benchmark and separate running-work enrollment remain outside this release.
